versions.changelog:
- Added optional Lobster pipeline support for parallel PR data gathering; falls back to `gh` CLI-only if Lobster is unavailable.
- New script suite: `run-pr-review.sh` (main entry), plus supporting fetch/merge scripts, enables one-step PR context collection as JSON.
- Updated documentation to describe Lobster integration, direct CLI fallback, new scripts, and usage examples.
- Skill now produces a normalized `pr-context-v0` envelope for analysis instead of issuing multiple sequential CLI calls.
- Removed legacy skill-card and adjusted references to reflect new workflow and integration options.
Initial release — 5-layer review framework, severity tiers, addressing workflow, customizable conventions and IaC checklist
